content: {"reasoning":"The PR-204 denial is already on the table, and no claim-data, COB, or authorization defect exists to correct; retro authorization is also unavailable and unnecessary. A clean resubmission would not address the plan-coverage denial, while a formal appeal is permitted and has paid similar claims at this payer. The payer path should therefore be challenged before transferring the contractual patient share or any valid noncovered liability to the patient.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
